name: Inside Job
description: For employees of the Deep State, conspiracies aren't just theories — they're fact. And keeping them a secret is a full-time job.

videos.title: Unpresidented
videos.overview: As Reagan prepares to replace the president with a robot, she finds her hard-earned promotion threatened by a clueless but likeable new colleague.

videos.title: Clone Gunman
videos.overview: When an expensive blunder forces budget cuts at Cognito Inc., J.R orders Reagan and Brett to decide which of their co-workers should be fired.

videos.title: Blue Bloods
videos.overview: After a lizard people-related PR disaster, the team must do damage control at the swanky Reptoid Gala, where - to Reagan's dismay - hugs are required.

videos.title: Sex Machina
videos.overview: After Cognito Inc. buys a dating app, Reagan bets her team she can find a boyfriend - and creates a robot version of her perfect match to practice on.

videos.title: The Brettfast Club
videos.overview: Brett hopes to have a blast in the past as the team embarks on a nostalgia-laced mission to a small town that's permanently stuck in the '80s.

videos.title: My Big Flat Earth Wedding
videos.overview: Reagan conspires to keep her dad from finding out about her mom's wedding, while J.R. ropes Brett into a personal mission to help offload his mega-yacht.

videos.title: Ghost Protocol
videos.overview: Reagan sets up an elaborate plan in motion to ghost a debonair British secret agent who grows too attached after a fling.

videos.title: Buzzkill
videos.overview: Desperate to get some space from her father, Reagan volunteers for a dangerous mission to the moon to make contact with a rogue colony.

videos.title: Mole Hunt
videos.overview: Exciting changes are afoot at Cognito Inc., but first, Reagan and her team must find the mole behind a security breach that could take down the company.

videos.title: Inside Reagan
videos.overview: To find a forgotten password and save Cognito Inc., Reagan goes deep into her mind and accesses memories from her dysfunctional childhood.

videos.title: How Reagan Got Her Grove Back
videos.overview: With Rand back in control of Cognito Inc., Reagan gets revenge — and has a hookup — at a Burning Man-style gathering of secret societies.

videos.title: Whoas-Feratu
videos.overview: Tamiko's new beau is a Hollywood A-lister with a taste for blood, but that doesn't stop a jealous Rand from trying to break up the cozy couple.

videos.title: Reagan & Mychelle's Hive School Reunion
videos.overview: The Cognito crew plays along with Magic Myc's big lies at a class reunion until he goes too far. Meanwhile, Rand finds a gross "gift" on his desk.

videos.title: We Found Love in a Popeless Place
videos.overview: Reagan has to turn the new, woke pope into a fire-and-brimstone pontiff, so she's off to Italy with a friend — and a little romance on the side.

videos.title: Brettwork
videos.overview: Brett's an overnight sensation when he sits in as the host of a right-wing TV show, but quickly becomes a political puppet gleefully controlled by Rand.

videos.title: Rontagion
videos.overview: Now that she's sleeping with the Illuminati, Reagan decides it's time for the Cognito Inc. gang to meet Ron and persuade him to jump ship.

videos.title: Project Reboot
videos.overview: Rand unleashes Project Reboot as the Cognito co-workers learn about their alternate lives — and how a tin foil hat can actually come in handy.

videos.title: Appleton
videos.overview: With Cognito under new leadership, Reagan meets with the Robes who want a partnership, but she needs to make a big decision about her future.
